findings.desc: quality-cleanup: packages/main/src/core/done-oracle.ts:36 imports recomputeDeliveryCheckHash from ../handlers/delivery-check.js — a core module importing from the handlers layer. This violates Core/Shell layer separation (core must not depend on handlers). The smoke test circular-import guard (flow-stability-smoke.ts:2838) only checks for story-advance imports, missing this handlers/delivery-check path. recomputeDeliveryCheckHash only uses StoryStore + crypto (pure core dependencies) and should be extracted to a core/ module (e.g. core/delivery-check-hash.ts) to sever the upward dependency.
